post.summary:
Commits a batch of mutations for a single instance.
For multipart requests, the first part must be the `mutation` JSON field;
each subsequent part must match exactly one `contentPartName` in the request.
Unknown, duplicate, or missing file parts are rejected with 400 Bad Request.
post.description:
After the endpoint's outer `InstanceWrite` policy admits the request, idempotent replay
is checked before process-state, presentation-text, data-value, per-data-type write,
complete-confirmation, and delete-instance authorization. A complete confirmation is
additionally subject to the `InstanceComplete` policy and is recorded for the calling
organisation only; an organisation that already has a confirmation keeps the one it has, and
the remaining operations commit either way. An admitted replay is a no-op and uses the snapshot
returned by replay admission. For non-replays, operation-specific authorization is evaluated
against the controller's instance snapshot; data-element update and delete references missing
from that snapshot are rejected by later plan validation. Process-state authorization admits a
mutation on an instance without a current task only from the app that owns the instance. A
delete-instance mutation returns 403 while the application's
`PreventInstanceDeletionForDays` period, counted from when the instance was archived, has
not passed. A delete-instance mutation checks instance existence before delete authorization,
so a missing instance returns 404 before a possible delete-policy 403.

parameters.name: deleteGeneratedElements
parameters.description:
Optional `deleteGeneratedElements` query parameter, bound as a nullable boolean. Defaults to
`true` when absent: on task entry this controller deletes the data elements generated from the
entered task, exactly as it always has. A caller that manages its own task-generated data cleanup
(e.g. a v9 app, which prunes those elements at task start) opts out with `deleteGeneratedElements=false`
so this controller does not delete elements it just created. A non-boolean value is rejected with
`400 Bad Request` by model binding - a caller sending this deliberate parameter is expected to
encode a valid boolean.

The data for fields specified here will automatically be copied and populated on the Altinn.Platform.Storage.Interface.Models.Instance model as data values,
making them easily available for routing or other needs without having to load the entire data set.

id.description:
Gets or sets the data type id.
It must be unique within the scope of an application. Logical name of the schema of which data elements should be validated against.
Should be in lower case and can only contain letters, dash and numbers. No space or slashes are allowed.
Examples are: main, subschema-x, cv, attachment

Value should be preceded by an approved key.
If null or empty no contributer restrictions are set.

dataId.description: The data element which the event refers to, or null.

eventType.description: The event type, e.g. created, saved, process-change.

InstanceEvent.description: Represents the an event related to an instance.

instanceEvents.description: The actual list of instance events.

InstanceEventList.description: Represents a container object with a list of events related to instances.

ttlSeconds.description: Gets or sets the time to live in seconds.

InstanceLockRequest.description: Represents a request to acquire or update an instance lock.

lockToken.description: Gets or sets the lock token.

InstanceLockResponse.description: Represents a response when acquiring an instance lock.

createdDataElementIds.description: Storage-generated ids for created data elements, in createDataElements request order.

replayed.description: Whether this response was replayed from a previously committed idempotent mutation.

InstanceMutationResponse.description: Response body from an aggregate instance mutation.

partyId.description: Gets or sets the party id of the instance owner (also called instance owner party id).

partyUuid.description: Gets or sets the party uuid of the instance owner.

personNumber.description: Gets or sets person number (national identification number) of the party. Null if the party is not a person.

organisationNumber.description: Gets or sets the organisation number of the party. Null if the party is not an organisation.

username.description:
Gets or sets the username of the party.
For self identifier users.
Legacy sets this as a username, new id porten email self identification sets this as email on the form "epost:[email]"

externalIdentifier.description:
Gets or sets an external identifier for the party.
This is used for self identifier users, on the form "urn:altinn:person:idporten-email:[email]"
or "urn:altinn:person:legacy-selfidentified:[username]".

InstanceOwner.description: Represents information to identify the owner of an instance.

count.description: The number of items in this response.

next.description: A link to the next page.

isArchived.description: Gets or sets if the instance is archived.

archived.description: Gets or sets the date the instance was archived.

isSoftDeleted.description: Gets or sets if the instance is soft deleted.

softDeleted.description: Gets or sets the date the instance was deleted.

isHardDeleted.description: Gets or sets if the instance is hard deleted.

hardDeleted.description: Gets or sets the date the instance was marked for hard delete by user.

InstanceStatus.description:
Represents set of statuses used by the message box to determine
where to show the instance and which icons to use.

key.description: The key. Must be unique within the list.

MessageBoxConfig.description: Class that holds the message box configuration for an application.

show.description: Defines what should be shown on entry.

bankruptcyEstate.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether a bankruptcy estate is allowed to be the owner of an instance.

organisation.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether an organisation is allowed to be the owner of an instance.

person.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether a person is allowed to be the owner of an instance.

subUnit.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether a sub unit is allowed to be the owner of an instance.

PartyTypesAllowed.description:
Represents a set of settings where application owner can define what types of parties
that are allowed to be owners of an instance in an application.

userId.description: Gets or sets the unique user id as given by Altinn, or null if the user is an organisation user.

orgId.description: Gets or sets the altinn org identifier of the organisation that were identified by maskinporten.

authenticationLevel.description: Gets or sets the authentication level for the user which triggered the event

endUserSystemId.description: Gets or sets the end user system that were used triggered the event.

nationalIdentityNumber.description: Gets or sets the national identity number of the person that triggered the event.

systemUserId.description: Gets or sets the ID of the system user that triggered the event.

systemUserOwnerOrgNo.description: Gets or sets the organization number of the owner of the system user that triggered the event.

systemUserName.description: Gets or sets the name of the system user that triggered the event.

PlatformUser.description:
Information about the platform user, that is the identity of the client doing the action and his/hers authentication level.
It can be a person (UserId) or an organisation (OrgId). And the user can have logged in via an end user system or not.

texts.description: The actual collection of texts to be added to

PresentationTexts.description: Represents the body of a PUT request against the presentationtexts endpoint for Instance.

flow.description: Gets or sets the sequence number of the various tasks and event elements that have been reached by this process.

started.description: Gets or sets the date and time for when the current task was started.

elementId.description: Gets or sets a reference to the current task/event element id as given in the process definition.

name.description: Gets or sets the name of the process element

altinnTaskType.description: Gets or sets an altinn specific task type which specifies the wanted behaviour of the task.

ended.description: Gets or sets  the date and time when the task was ended (closed/completed)

flowType.description: Gets or sets the last flowtype.

ProcessElementInfo.description: Represents a set of properties with information about the current task/event element in a process

performedBy.description: An identifier of the entity that performed the action. Organisation number, person identification number or user name.

ProcessHistoryItem.description:
Model for process history items.
Represents a step in an instances' process and holds metadata.

processHistory.description: The actual list of process history items.

ProcessHistoryList.description: Represents a container object with a list of process history items.

started.description: Gets or sets the date and time for when the process was started.

startEvent.description: Gets or sets the event that was used to start the process.

ended.description: Gets or sets the date and time for then the process ended/completed.

endEvent.description: Gets or sets the end event of the process.

ProcessState.description:
Represents a status object that holds the process state of an application instance.
The process is defined by the application's process specification BPMN file.

events.description: The instance events produced during process/next

ProcessStatus.description:
Storage-controlled process status values. The wire spelling is the lowercase member name, which
the persisted instance and every SQL process-status comparison depend on.

Reference.description: Reference to other objects in storage

ReferenceType.description: The type of the connected object

RelationType.description: The type of relation to the connected object

apps.description: Gets or sets the application resource link. It is null if data is fetched from platform storage.

platform.description: Gets or sets platform resource link.

ResourceLinks.description: Represent actual links to resources in various endpoints.

prefix.description: Gets or sets the prefix to use to filter out shadow fields.

saveToDataType.description:
Gets or sets the data type to save filtered data (without shadow fields) to.
Optional. If not set, the containing data type will be updated.

ShadowFields.description: Represents an object with information about how shadow fields are configured for the data type.

signatureDocumentDataType.description: The data type to use of the generated signature document

generatedFromTask.description: The task which should be linked to this signature

SignRequest.description: Represents all dataElements with signing status

systemUserId.description: The ID of the systemuser performing the signing

label.description: A text key pointing to a short description of the substatus.

description.description: A text key pointing to a longer description of the substatus.

disableSync.description:
Gets or sets the flag controlling whether the sync adapter should disable all dialog synchronization.
This overrides all other settings.

enableUserSuppliedDialogId.description:
Gets or sets the flag controlling whether the sync adapter should create a dialogId or use user-
supplied dialogId. If true, the sync adapter will use the dialogId found in DataValues with key: dialog.id.

disableCreate.description: Gets or sets the flag controlling whether the sync adapter should disable dialog creation.

disableDelete.description: Gets or sets the flag controlling whether the sync adapter should disable dialog deletion.

disableAddActivities.description: Gets or sets the flag controlling whether the sync adapter should disable adding activities.

disableAddTransmissions.description: Gets or sets the flag controlling whether the sync adapter should disable adding transmissions.

disableSyncDueAt.description: Gets or sets the flag controlling whether the sync adapter should disable synchronizing (overwrite) the due at date.

disableSyncStatus.description: Gets or sets the flag controlling whether the sync adapter should disable synchronizing (overwrite) the status.

disableMarkCompletedWhenConfirmed.description: Gets or sets the flag controlling whether the sync adapter should set status to completed when confirmed.

disableSyncContentTitle.description: Gets or sets the flag controlling whether the sync adapter should disable synchronizing (overwrite) the title.

disableSyncContentSummary.description: Gets or sets the flag controlling whether the sync adapter should disable synchronizing (overwrite) the summary.

disableSyncContentAdditionalInformation.description: Gets or sets the flag controlling whether the sync adapter should disable synchronizing (overwrite) the additional information.

disableSyncContentExtendedStatus.description: Gets or sets the flag controlling whether the sync adapter should disable synchronizing (overwrite) the extended status.

disableSyncAttachments.description:
Gets or sets the flag controlling whether the sync adapter should disable synchronizing attachments at the dialog level.
Will only add/remove attachments with recognized id's, which are derived from the URL.

disableSyncApiActions.description:
Gets or sets the flag controlling whether the sync adapter should disable synchronizing API actions.
Will only add/remove API actions with recognized id's, which are derived from the URL.

disableSyncGuiActions.description:
Gets or sets the flag controlling whether the sync adapter should disable synchronizing GUI actions.
Will only add/remove GUI actions with recognized id's, which are derived from the URL.

SyncAdapterSettings.description: A class to hold sync adapter settings

id.description: Gets or sets the unique id of the text resource, format {org}-{app}-{language} e.g. ttd-demoapp-nb

org.description: Gets or sets the org, used as a partition key

language.description: Gets or sets the language. Should be a two letter ISO name.

resources.description: Gets or sets a list of text resource elements

TextResource.description: Represents a set of texts on a specified language.

TextResourceElement.description: Represents the actual texts identified by the key.

TextResourceVariable.description: Represents a replacement variable if any element in the text should be replaced.

timestamp.description: Gets or sets the date and time of the last validation of task.

canCompleteTask.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the validation was successful and that the task can be completed.

ValidationStatus.description: Represents the validation status of a data element.

JwtCookie.description: JWT Authorization header using the Bearer scheme. Example: "Authorization: Bearer {token}". Remember to add "Bearer" to the input below before your token.
